{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data and deduplicate by highest sample_seq
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the site distribution
print("Site distribution:")
print(trial_df['site'].value_counts())

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {best_site} ({best_rate:.3f})")"}
